title: Software Developer - Java / Python (Chicago)
description:
Job Title: Software Developer - Java / Python (Chicago)

Location: Chicago (Hybrid 3 Days a week)

Company: Financial Services

Pay: $120 000 – $160 000

Experience level: 3 – 7 years

Position Overview:

We are looking for a highly motivated developer (Java and Python) with an excitement for solving complex problems. The developer must be able to work in a team environment and provide input to resolve technical problems. Experience in an Agile based programming environment is a plus, the developer will be asked to provide estimates for assigned work. Excitement for technology and development is a must.

The following are the required skill sets:
- Java Development
- Python
- Database Experience - SQL
- Object-oriented programming

The following are the desired skill sets:
- Experience in Agile Development Methodology
- Java Enterprise Development
- JBoss Platform experience
- Drools
- Spring
- Hibernate
- Maven
- Web Services
- Oracle
- JUnit

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $120,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:
• 401(k)
• Dental insurance
• Health insurance
• Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
